name: ResearchFactory
description: Six Kiro Flock nodes research one topic from different angles and argue it out in a single shared document until nobody has anything new to add.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.value: the fastest animal on the planet

parameters.name: context
parameters.value: wikipedia and the scientific corners of the internet
parameters.description: Where the nodes should look first. Their general knowledge is used as well.

loops.name: Researcher
loops.prompt: Look at @context and research @topic from your own distinct angle. Read your neighbours' findings and argue with them: challenge weak claims, offer counter-evidence, and defend your position rather than converging early. Write your consolidated research finding into the one shared file @project/research.md. All nodes edit that same file: re-read it each turn and correct or extend what your neighbours wrote rather than overwriting it. The argument must end: once your position has survived a neighbour's challenge unchanged, or you have nothing new to add, treat the research as concluded and declare no further work rather than re-litigating settled points.
